page.overview:
Who is Valera Gorovni?

Valera Gorovni was an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah., Valera Gorovni}}

She was short, little and plump, always wearing a smile. She seemed to be bustling even while standing still.

Valera has a strength in the One Power of . She is very strong for an Aes Sedai. Less than a dozen Aes Sedai are known to have been stronger than her at the time of her death.

She was born in the year . Her name may indicate she is Kandori.
